title: ICT Installation & Configuration
titleLarge: Professional setup of hardware, software, and systems from day one
desc: Professional setup of hardware, software, and systems to ensure smooth performance from day one.
shortDesc: Workstations, servers, networks, CCTV, and AV installed and configured to spec.
desc1: We install and configure the technology your team uses every day so it works together from the start. That includes endpoints, servers, networks, security systems, and meeting-room AV, with baseline hardening and tidy handover.
desc2: Our technicians size, mount, cable, and test each environment against your requirements, then document settings so support and growth stay straightforward.
desc3: From a single office fit-out to a multi-site rollout, we keep deployments practical, secure, and ready for day-one use.

process.title: What we install
processItems: Devices & Endpoints — workstations, laptops, tablets, printers, and accessories
Servers & Storage — installation, configuration, and baseline hardening
Networks & Wi-Fi — switches, routers, access points, and controllers
Security & Surveillance — CCTV, access control, and alarm systems
Audio Visual — video conferencing, interactive displays, and room systems

title: Network Design & Implementation
titleLarge: Secure, efficient, and scalable networks from campus to cloud
desc: End-to-end design and deployment of secure, efficient, and scalable networks.
shortDesc: LAN, WAN, wireless, SD-WAN, structured cabling, and performance tuning.
desc1: We design and deploy networks that stay reliable as you grow—campus, branch, and cloud. Coverage, capacity, and security are planned together so applications perform and users stay connected.
desc2: Whether you need a new LAN, outdoor Wi-Fi, SD-WAN across branches, or standards-based cabling, we survey the site, specify the right kit, and implement with clear documentation.
desc3: After go-live we tune QoS and monitor performance so the network keeps pace with your workloads.

process.title: Network scope
processItems: LAN & WAN Design — resilient architectures for campus and branch connectivity
Wireless Networks — indoor and outdoor Wi-Fi with coverage and capacity planning
SD-WAN Implementation — optimized application performance across branches and cloud
Structured Cabling — standards-based copper and fiber installations
Network Optimization — tuning, QoS, and performance improvements

title: Cybersecurity Deployment & Hardening
titleLarge: Layered security controls and best practices for Kenyan businesses
desc: Protect your business with modern, layered security controls and best practices.
shortDesc: Firewalls, EDR, MFA, email security, and vulnerability hardening.
desc1: We deploy layered security that matches how your people actually work—office, remote, and cloud. Policies, identity, endpoints, and email are treated as one system, not separate products.
desc2: From next-generation firewalls and VPNs to EDR, MFA, and anti-phishing, we design, implement, and harden configurations so you are protected without blocking the business.
desc3: Regular scans and baselines keep the environment from drifting after go-live.

process.title: Security controls
processItems: Firewalls & Gateways — policy design, IPS/IDS, VPNs, and secure remote access
Endpoint Protection — anti-malware, EDR, and posture management for devices
Identity & Access — MFA, SSO, PAM, and zero-trust access controls
Email & Cloud Security — anti-phishing, DLP, and secure collaboration
Vulnerability Hardening — scans, remediation, and configuration baselines

title: Cloud Services & Migration
titleLarge: Move to the cloud smoothly and operate efficiently once you are there
desc: Move to the cloud smoothly and operate efficiently once you are there.
shortDesc: Microsoft 365, data migration, cloud backup, hybrid integration, and cost control.
desc1: We help you choose the right cloud plans, migrate with minimal downtime, and run Microsoft 365, backup, and hybrid workloads without surprise costs.
desc2: Tenant setup, licensing, security, and lifecycle management are handled together so collaboration stays secure and predictable.
desc3: After migration we right-size licences and governance so spend stays aligned to actual use.

process.title: Cloud scope
processItems: Microsoft 365 — tenant setup, licensing, security, and lifecycle management
Data Migration — email, files, and workloads moved with minimal downtime
Cloud Backup — policies and tooling for reliable recovery and retention
Hybrid Integration — connect on-prem systems with cloud apps and services
Cost Optimization — right-sizing and governance for predictable spending

title: IT Support & Maintenance
titleLarge: Reliable, timely support to keep systems running without interruptions
desc: Reliable, timely support to keep systems running without interruptions.
shortDesc: Onsite and remote helpdesk, SLAs, preventive maintenance, and health checks.
desc1: When something breaks, you need a team that answers and fixes it. We provide onsite and remote support with clear escalation, plus preventive checks so issues are caught early.
desc2: Service contracts can include agreed response and resolution times, periodic health checks, and root-cause work—not just ticket closing.
desc3: We support endpoints, networks, servers, and printers so your staff can stay focused on the business.

process.title: Support model
processItems: Onsite & Remote Support — helpdesk, field engineers, and escalation paths
Preventive Maintenance — routine checks that prevent issues before they occur
Troubleshooting & Diagnostics — root-cause analysis and corrective actions
Service Contracts & SLAs — response and resolution commitments you can rely on
Health Checks — periodic assessments of networks, servers, and endpoints

title: IT Consulting & Advisory
titleLarge: Guidance on technology decisions for growth, security, and efficiency
desc: Guidance on the best technology decisions for growth, security, and efficiency.
shortDesc: ICT roadmaps, assessments, budgeting, governance, and cost optimization.
desc1: We help you decide what to buy, what to keep, and what to retire. Advice is tied to your timelines and budget, not a product catalogue.
desc2: Current-state reviews, phased roadmaps, and investment priorities give leadership a clear picture of risk and return.
desc3: The goal is practical ICT that supports the business without waste.

process.title: Advisory scope
processItems: ICT Strategy & Roadmaps — plan phased improvements aligned to business goals
Assessments & Audits — current-state reviews with actionable recommendations
Budgeting & Governance — prioritize investments and manage risk effectively
Cost Optimization — eliminate waste and increase return on IT spend

title: System Integration Services
titleLarge: Integrate different technologies into one smooth, unified environment
desc: Integrate different technologies into one smooth, unified environment.
shortDesc: Application integration, APIs, multi-vendor alignment, and workflow automation.
desc1: Most organisations already run several systems. We connect them so data flows, staff stop re-keying, and vendors do not work in isolation.
desc2: APIs, middleware, and workflow automation reduce manual work while keeping each platform within its supported design.
desc3: Multi-vendor environments are aligned so upgrades and support remain predictable.

process.title: Integration scope
processItems: Application Integration — connect business apps for seamless data flow
APIs & Middleware — build reliable bridges between systems and partners
Multi-Vendor Alignment — make diverse solutions work together reliably
Workflow Automation — reduce manual tasks and improve consistency

processItems: Server Room Setup — layout, power, cooling, and environmental considerations

title: Training & User Support
titleLarge: Empower teams to use technology confidently and securely
desc: Empower teams with the knowledge to use technology confidently and securely.
shortDesc: End-user and admin training, product demos, and security awareness.
desc1: New systems only pay off if people can use them. We train end users and administrators, run product demos, and raise security awareness so risk drops and adoption stays high.
desc2: Sessions are practical and tied to the tools you actually run—Microsoft 365, security platforms, and line-of-business apps.
desc3: We leave your team able to operate day to day, not dependent on a one-off handover.

process.title: Training scope
processItems: End-User Training — productivity tips and best practices
Admin Training — configuration, policies, and daily operations
Product Demos — hands-on sessions to evaluate solutions

title: Project Management & Deployment Oversight
titleLarge: ICT projects delivered on time, within budget, and to quality standards
desc: Ensure ICT projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to quality standards.
shortDesc: Site surveys, planning, vendor coordination, supervision, and commissioning.
desc1: Complex ICT work needs a single owner. We survey sites, plan timelines, coordinate vendors, and supervise implementation through testing and handover.
desc2: Documentation, responsibilities, and acceptance criteria are agreed up front so surprises are caught early.

processItems: Site Surveys — accurate scoping and risk identification
Planning & Documentation — clear timelines, responsibilities, and records
Vendor Coordination — align partners and deliveries to the plan

Testing & Commissioning — acceptance criteria met before handover

title: Repair & Technical Recovery Services
titleLarge: Restore hardware and systems quickly and safely
desc: Skilled technicians to restore hardware and systems quickly and safely.
shortDesc: Laptops, desktops, printers, networks, and servers diagnosed and recovered.
desc1: When hardware fails, we diagnose first, then repair or recover so you are not replacing what can be saved. PCs, printers, networks, and servers are all in scope.
desc2: Root-cause analysis reduces repeat failures. Parts, OS recovery, and calibration are handled by technicians who work on the same brands we supply.
desc3: Fast, safe recovery keeps downtime short for offices and sites across Nairobi and beyond.

process.title: Recovery scope
processItems: Laptops & Desktops — hardware repairs, parts replacement, and OS recovery
Printers & Copiers — servicing, maintenance, and calibration
Networks — connectivity troubleshooting and fixes
Servers — recovery, rebuilds, and performance restoration
Diagnostics — root-cause analysis to prevent repeat issues
